# Cargo Leaderboard

> A community leaderboard for the artifact footprint of Rust builds, bytes reclaimed by cargo clean, and build duration. Nicknames and scores are self-reported.

## Set up a Rust project

- [Agent setup instructions](/agents.md): Read when installing the CLI, configuring a nickname or server, or making and verifying a first submission. Includes noninteractive setup and existing-configuration handling.
- [Manual CLI guide](https://github.com/alexlwn123/cargo-leaderboard#manual-setup): Platform installers, configuration, measurements, privacy, and troubleshooting.

## Explore

- [Leaderboard](/): Biggest builds, biggest cleans, and longest waits.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/alexlwn123/cargo-leaderboard/releases/latest): Native binaries and SHA-256 checksums.
